name: Sheveluch explosive eruptions, Kamchatka: ground around the lava domes changed, 22 Sep-4 Oct 2026
in_app_note: Withdrawn from the app on 15 Nov 2026: the lost coherence rises steadily with elevation (8 % at 600-900 m to 77 % at 1500-1800 m) and hardly depends on distance from the domes, and it does not recover in the next pair, so first autumn snow explains it. Verdict marginal. Kept as a tried event.
